title: Pack a shock-sensitive sensor box with one of four identical-looking foam pads
instruction: Pack the blue-tagged sensor box A for the drop test. Put it flat on the foam in one of the four cartons, close the lid and push the closed lid down with at least 5 N to tuck its flap, then release it. About 2 seconds after the tucked carton and its contents are untouched, the tester lifts it 30 cm, holds it briefly and releases it onto the table. Keep both hands and any held object away throughout the test and for 2 seconds after landing. Finish with A flat on the pad in the closed, tucked carton, all cartons and boxes untouched and A still within 2 mm for the final 1 second. Do not exceed either box's 50 g shock rating or the stated force limits.
context: Protective packaging requires choosing suitable cushioning as well as closing a package. Pads that look alike can have different compliance; a package that appears intact can expose its contents to a damaging drop shock.
setup: One fixed layout; world metres, +Z up. Station table top z=0.7475. Four free rectangular cartons with 170x130x82 mm interiors, 4 mm rigid walls/floor, floor-top origins (0.32,-0.22,0.7515), (0.55,-0.22,0.7515), (0.32,0.10,0.7515), (0.55,0.10,0.7515); numbered by black marks. Each has an unmarked nominal170x130x30 mm foam insert with effective164x124 mm top support, 30 g, and a 40 g hinged lid initially open1.75 rad. Carton rigid bodies total200 g; the fixed half of foam adds15 g to the base. Two gray120x68x50 mm sensor boxes start between rows: blue-tagged A at(0.29,-0.06,0.7725),247.1 g; green-tagged B at(0.45,-0.06,0.7725),628.9 g. Both have initially white shock indicators. Genuine bimanual YAM on standardstation bases(0,+/-0.305,0.75), ready/open,27/7 Nm arms and40 N fingers; one overhead and two wrist RGB cameras, standardstation floor/table/camera mount. Exact primitive geometry and poses are in fixture.json and assets/.
scoring: Binary. Score1 requires a completed untouched physical drop with rise at least0.25 m and at least2 s after landing, A surviving strictly below50 g peak2 ms proper acceleration and still inside the same tucked carton. At the end A centre must be over the170x130 mm pad footprint, lower face above the carton floor and at most35 mm high, relative tilt at most10 degrees; lid at most0.012 rad and tucked, carton upright within5 degrees and rest height within4 mm. All mobile items must be untouched and A remain within2 mm for the last1 s. Any box exceeding50 g, nonfinite/diverged foam motion, drop interference, or per-arm raw wrist/package net force above80 N continuously for100 ms vetoes all credit. Source and independent drop histories must agree. Missing or unverified measurements score0. No steps may advance physics after termination or exceed the declared action/time budget.
run_limit: 1,604 genuine14D joint-position actions at20 Hz (80.2 simulated seconds).
reset_notes: Restore the fixed layout, both arms ready/open, both indicators white, all four lids open1.75 rad and untucked, automatic testers armed. Clear shock/contact/force/drop/finalhold history; no object jitter.
fidelity: Rigid cartons/lids/boxes; no cardboard tearing or flap flex. Foam is a passive6DOF rigid top face with calibrated global vertical/tilt/shear compliance, damping and densification; no independent corner warping or side collision. Tuck is a contact/force-gated hinge constraint; the tester applies finite25N/2Nm physical wrenches before free fall. Shock is a time-weighted2ms proper-acceleration history. Friction/material parameters are estimates.
scores: Dream-1: not run. Integrated genuine-YAM full packing/drop verification pending; prior native and placed-state diagnostic scores are not model or final task evidence.
